mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM decline > 1% does not correspond to negative 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp in 3 months but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM increase > 1% does not correspond to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the previous 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS shows a sustained decrease.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between rising Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) and falling Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increase > 0.3pp in 3 months AND PAYEMS MoM decline
failure_condition: If the combined signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS does not correspond to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a weakening in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM decline > 5% does not correspond to negative 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decline in Real GDP (GDPC1) and an increase in Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ decline > 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL annualized growth > 2%
failure_condition: If the combined signal of declining GDPC1 and rising CPIAUCSL does not correspond to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of the cases.
